ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity white pixels to 55% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central regions of both lobes feature large, irregular white geometric masses. The right lobe displays higher frequency dark stippling and mottling within the white field. Both lobes are encased in a continuous, high-contrast black boundary of varying thickness along all visible edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression; estimated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees with a deep bounding-box penetration relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. The left lobe exhibits more pronounced, sharp vertical peaks compared to the smoother, undulating serrations on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex curvature along the primary trailing edge, transitioning to acute, pointed lateral tips (termini).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of small, dark, circular high-contrast pixel groups visible in the medial-inner section of the right lobe's white pigmentation area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, roughly parallel dark linear streaks (rake marks) traversing diagonally from the upper-left toward the lower-center on the left lobe's white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible rake marks on the left lobe; irregular, possibly chipped pixel morphology on the far left trailing edge tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, granular speckling pattern concentrated specifically in the center-right region of the right lobe's white zone.
